Method of Attack: Code injection vulnerability exploiting Merge Tags feature
Remote code execution via deserialization and object injection
Unserialized user-supplied content leading to arbitrary code execution or file deletion
Discoverer: Wordfence threat intelligence lead Chloe Chamberland
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Ninja Forms plugin
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated remote exploitation via Merge Tags feature
Indicators of Compromise: Force-updated plugin versions downloaded over 730,000 times since June 14 patch
Evidence of ongoing exploitation in the wild
